Ashwani Kumar Mishra, J. (Oral)
Delay of 112 days in filing of the application has been satisfactorily explained.
Accordingly, application is allowed and delay of 112 days in filing the application is condoned.

CM-19592-CWP-2025 This application is filed for restoration of main Writ Petition i.e.
CWP-10618-2022 which was dismissed for non-prosecution by this Court vide order dated 01.08.2025.
Sufficient cause has been shown for non-appearance on behalf of the counsel for the petitioner.
Consequently, the present application is allowed.

The main Writ Petition is restored to its original number & position and is taken on board for hearing today itself. CWP-10618-2022 (O&M)
1.
The petitioner claims to be a Street Vendor.

It is submitted that he has appropriate licence/certificate from the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India, yet the Municipal Corporation, Bhatinda and its officials are not allowing the petitioner to work as a Street Vendor.

sentences.text: This petition was filed in the year 2022 and till date, notice in this petition has not been issued.
The petition was dismissed twice for non-prosecution by this Court.

sentences.text: 4. In the event petitioner makes a comprehensive representation, before the authorities concerned along with copy of this order, the same shall be decided by passing an appropriate order within a period of six months.

5. It is made clear that the question as to whether the petitioner has a valid licence or entitlement in law, to function as such, is left open for examination by the competent authority at the first instance.
